claims.text: The monthly payment is the standard fixed-rate payment, exact to the cent.
Total paid is the sum of every monthly payment, exact to the cent.
Total interest is the sum of each month's interest, rounded half up to the cent each month.
Cost of borrowing is total interest plus the upfront fees you typed.
Months saved and interest saved compare the plain schedule with the same schedule plus your extra payment.
The by-year table adds up to the totals, and the balance ends at zero.
A rate of 0, a one-month loan and a 1,200-month loan all work out exactly.
Messy typing never gives a wrong number, NaN or a crash.
A bad entry gets a calm message in plain words that names the field.
